why_build_is_authorized: Architecture sufficiently proven: unified Wix CLI app (Astro-based), dashboard extensions, Bookings Validation service plugin, Calendar V3 schedule shaping, data collections persistence, Wix-managed hosting — every load-bearing claim independently verified against current official docs on 2026-08-24.
No deprecated path in the chosen stack; legacy CLI and Bookings-scoped Calendar APIs explicitly banned in the contract.

All 10 MVP capabilities classified STABLE_PRODUCTION per current official documentation; no PREVIEW_GATED capability is required for the MVP; UNSUPPORTED items (native per-location hours objects, unconditional reschedule enforcement) are excluded from scope and from copy.
Monetization model is the documented Wix pattern: 4 fixed recurring plans + developer-computed billable-location meter + developer-enforced restriction + upgrade URL.
Audit blockers B1-B7 are contract-writing tasks, not research gaps; all seven are resolved in docs/WIX_TECHNICAL_CONTRACT.md (see blocker_resolution below).
Remaining unknowns are empirical dev-site gates that block production CLAIMS, not build start (audit §8); credential-free builder work is explicitly sanctioned by the audit.

blocker_resolution.B1_contactId_unproven: Contract C1 + §5.3: identity-free-first duplicate protection; T-VP3 amended into payload probe incl. metadata.identity.
blocker_resolution.B2_contradiction_invariants: Contract C2 (expirationDate/expiresOn advisory-only) and C3 (queryLocations.exists ban).
blocker_resolution.B3_counting_signoff: Contract C5 + §7: paginated locations+services, archived=false liveness, non-hidden counted-service policy v1, single-location floor 0->1, fail-open entitlement errors with dashboard warning.
blocker_resolution.B4_schema_drift: Contract C4: persistence tolerates older collection schemas; lazy reconciliation; blueprint persistence module owns it.
blocker_resolution.B5_gate_ordering: T-VP0 embedded as first integration-lane empirical step with documented dashboard-created-extension fallback; cycle-1 integration task prepares everything short of credentials.
blocker_resolution.B7_quarantine: Contract §13 UQ1-UQ9 marked UNVERIFIED; must not be asserted anywhere in accepted work.

residual_risks_accepted: Validation plugin shipped ~2026-04; classified STABLE_PRODUCTION per current docs but production claims gated on T-VP0-T-VP5 passing on a dev site.
Reschedule enforcement is permanently best-effort (documented fail-open).
TOCTOU residual risk on count caps disclosed in-product.
Empirical gates require human-owned credentials; until then builders ship credential-free value only.
